summary.text: Bill Vest, listed by Ballotpedia as William Vest, was appointed to the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 50 on August 25, 2026, and is a write-in independent candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bill Vest was appointed to the House of Delegates by Governor Patrick Morrisey on August 25, 2026, to replace David Pritt.

sources.title: West Virginia House of Delegates elections, 2026
